title: Assessing the potential of exposure to endocrine disrupting chemicals through greywater reuse practices in Ghana: a scoping review
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00749F, Paper
Gloria Appiah Nsiah, Eugene Appiah-Effah, Otakuye Conroy-Ben
Greywater from kitchens, bathrooms, and laundry contains a diverse range of micropollutants with endocrine-disrupting potential. In Ghana, informal reuse may increase unrecognized health risks (image created using https://Biorender.com).
